_comment: Craft app CLIs bundled into the Studio image. Only list an app here after checking by hand that its --automation-read-root/--automation-write-root flags refuse every path outside the root (absolute paths, ../, and symlinks), because Studio runs one copy per signed-in user on a shared server. sha256 values are the release's linux tarballs, copied from its SHA256SUMS.txt.
